  <text x="20" y="224" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Choose your departure and destination</text>

  <rect x="17" y="239" width="356" height="126" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.04"/>
